title: Action card
description: A multi-use card from the shared action deck. One use is chosen per play; the rest are void. See DOCS/domain-model.md.

copies.description: How many identical copies of this card are in the deck.

summary.description: Concise source-reviewed gameplay paraphrase; not a full printed-card transcription.

movement.description: Steps granted when the card is used for movement.

activates.description: The card's ACTION part (the small reversed strip): abilities the card can be spent on when played directly. Independent of the attach use below.

attach.description: The card's main use: attaching to a target, and what it confers there.

class.description: Target class restriction: the classes this card may attach to (e.g. Cleaner pawns).

grants.description: Abilities this attachment GIVES its target (e.g. a weapon grants Delete). May include move.

removes.description: Abilities this attachment STRIPS from its target (the cross-marked badge).

perTurn.description: A fixed number of uses per turn.

dice.description: Uses per turn are a d6 roll instead of a fixed count.

activation.description: Or the granted ability is card-activated / once-per-turn.

abilityUses.description: How a granted ability may be used: a fixed perTurn count, a d6 roll, or card/once-per-turn activation.

faces.description: Specific die faces this attachment grants to the target's ICE.

deltaDice.description: Change to the number of ICE dice (+/-).

black.description: Adds/uses a black ICE die: a failed Icebreak against it eliminates the attacking pawn.

iceModifier.description: Modifies the target's ICE: specific faces granted, more/fewer dice, and/or a black die.

drawModifier.description: Change to the number of cards drawn per turn (+/-).

handModifier.description: Change to the target's max hand size (+/-).

blockSpace.description: When as=block, the card becomes a single-space mini-block on a block side; this is its printed shape.

effectText.description: Special on-attach effect text, e.g. "Gain control of this pawn."

effectTrigger.description: When effectText fires; defaults to on-attach.

assetRefs.description: Physical asset ids resolved through spec/assets/manifest.json.
